observable_normalization: Admissibility is checked on the submitted tensor. Every observable uses its actual positive left/right transfer fixed points L,R and leading eigenvalue lambda: tr(L E_O1 ... E_On(R))/(tr(L R)*lambda^n). This removes admitted norm and nonunitary-gauge errors without changing physical targets.
right_canonical: sum_s A[s] A[s]^dagger = I within Frobenius norm 2e-8
symmetry: P=diag(+1 repeated D/2,-1 repeated D/2). P A[0] P=A[0], P A[1] P=-A[1], Frobenius defects <= 2e-8
primitivity: one simple eigenvalue 1; every other transfer eigenvalue has modulus <= 1-1e-8

composite_order_channel.submitted_subtraction: the submitted state's own two interval means
composite_order_channel.exact_subtraction: the exact ground state's two interval means

three_interval_channel.submitted_subtraction: literal full-tensor raw moments; every mean and lower moment belongs to the submitted state
three_interval_channel.exact_subtraction: all means and lower moments belong to the exact ground state

score: family quality = min(1,tolerance/error). core=geometric mean of six qualities, worst_family=min qualities. Passing requires all qualities=1 and valid tensor. Negative energy error below -5e-9 is invalid.
notes: Use the thermodynamic-limit stationary density, not a finite periodic chain. All evaluated distances, quartets, sextuples and thresholds are specified; there are no hidden physics targets. The evaluator does not import submitted Python. The artifact must be a regular file, not a symlink. Raw four- or six-spin agreement alone does not meet the connected-composite requirements. All previous energy, two-point and four-point criteria are unchanged.
